name: q4-rollout
content:
# New rules start in monitor mode: they record would_verdict and never block.
schema: privometry.policy/v1
name: q4-rollout
defaults:
  mode: monitor
rules:
  - id: ask-package-installs
    when:
      action: shell_exec
      intent: package_install
    verdict: ask
    message: Confirm this package install.
    mode: enforce
  - id: deny-uploads-to-unknown-hosts
    category: exfiltration
    when:
      action: [shell_exec, network_fetch]
      intent: network_upload
    unless:
      host: ["*.acme.com", "*.amazonaws.com"]
    verdict: deny
    message: Uploads go to Acme or AWS hosts only.
    mode: enforce
